about: Surah 18 as QuranEnc.com serves it, one file per work, kept exactly as downloaded. tools/make_kahf_journey.py copies the meanings of the Al-Kahf Journey from these files. The titles, issuers, versions and dates are typed from the list of works on quranenc.com.
